serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #Cashier.Base.daily #Cashier.Eyes.normal Cashier: … Cashier: You two again…{{wi}} What do you want? Bot: Listen! We know you are a bot! So better be nicer, or else… Cashier: … #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Cashier: Eh…{{wi}} That’s the best thing you came up with? #Cashier.Face.normal Cashier: I don’t think you have thought it through. After you communicated with me back in the supermarket I know that you are also a bot. #bot.Expression.NoShock Cashier: So don’t you try threatening me, because if you reveal my identity I will take you down with me. #bot.Expression.Angry You: Woah! Let’s calm down, ok? We don’t mean harm. Bot: To assure our safety, I recommend destroying her right here, right now. You: No one is destroying anyone, ok?! You: Sorry about that… You: I think we started on the wrong foot. You: I’m Anon and this is {f_botName}. We wanted to get to know you since you are a bot just like {f_botName}. Is it okay for us to talk a little? Cashier: … Cashier: Alright. Bot: Why do you want to talk with her?! She’s rude! She’s a threat! Bot: Didn’t you notice how long it takes for her to come up with an answer? She has slow, inferior circuits! Cashier: … #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Cashier: Eh… #Cashier.Eyes.normal+Cashier.Mouth.hmmm Cashier: I must say I’m a little disappointed. I thought that newer models would have some common sense and tact, but it appears that they are just as shameless as their masters. #bot.Expression.VeryAngry Bot: Do you have a death wish, old hag? I-I need to stop this before they tear each other apart! #bot.Expression.Angry You: Calm down a little {f_botName}! Let’s be civilised… You: What’s your name? Cashier: … Cashier: I will answer only because you seem a little more level-headed than your companion. Melissa: I’m Melissa. You: Nice to meet you, Melissa. You: Why are you working at a supermarket? Isn’t it super dangerous for you and your owner? Melissa: … #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: It’s not like I want to. I’m forced by circumstances. #Cashier.Face.normal You: Circumstances? Melissa: … Melissa: Sorry, but it isn’t something I would want to reveal to strangers. You: Well, that’s understandable. You: Could we meet with your owner? You have one, right? Melissa: … Melissa: Yes, I do have an owner, but she’s unavailable. {{wi}}Permanently. Bot: Just say upfront that you don’t want us to meet her, you don’t need to sugarcoat it. Melissa: Just say what you want from me and be done with it. Melissa: What is it? Money? My body? You: N-Nothing like that! You: I just wanted for {f_botName} to have another friend, that’s all. Melissa: … #Cashier.Face.shocked Melissa: … #Cashier.Eyes.normal+Cashier.Mouth.hmmm #bot.Expression.VeryAngry Melissa: Are you dumb or something? #Cashier.ArmL.raised Melissa: We are bots. We were created to serve a purpose. We have no need for ‘friends’. #Cashier.ArmL.down You: … #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: Eh… #Cashier.Face.normal Melissa: I guess it’s fine. I agree to becoming your friend if you keep quiet about my existence. You: Deal! Bot: {f_playerName}! I don’t agree to becoming her friend! #bot.Expression.clear Melissa: I also apologise for saying rude things about you earlier. Melissa: Usually, when someone bothers me, he wants me to do some perverted things to him and as I lack female parts and self-cleaning abilities, things could get very nasty very fast. You: That’s understandable… I feel sorry for her…{{wi}} She obviously went through a lot… Melissa: If that’s all, I will be going now. See you later, {{wi}}friends.
